thread:
maya: opened a docs PR to tighten up the private/vpc onprem install guide. main fixes: clarify KMS serviceaccount RBAC namespace, add CRI-O specific CA reload steps for air-gapped mirrors, and include a short puppet/ansible hint for nodes that need cert distribution. posting early for quick review.

sam: can you drop the PR link?

maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102 — file: docs/private/vpc/onprem_install.md. the current KMS snippet uses implicit SA and mentions containerd only. we have customers using cri-o and a few who manage node certs via puppet.

linh: good catch. for RBAC please make the SA explicit and namespace it under redwood-system. also add a note to run `kubectl auth can-i` after applying so customers can verify permissions.

alex: will do. i'll add a small snippet to create kms-sa and a RoleBinding. also will change the link to the canonical docs/reference/rbac.md to avoid absolute URLs.

alex:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: kms-sa
  namespace: redwood-system
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: redwood-kms-bind
  namespace: redwood-system
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: kms-sa
  namespace: redwood-system
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: kms-access
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```

maya: nice. for the airgap CA steps i'd like a short CRI-O example (we already have containerd in other pages). something like "copy CA to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors && update-ca-trust extract && systemctl restart crio" — that covers RHEL-based hosts.

sam: +1. also add a one-liner for Debian variants (update-ca-certificates && systemctl restart crio) so both families are covered.

linh: add a tiny puppet/ansible note: if customers use config management to distribute certs, remind them to run the CA install task before the installer and to restart the CRI on each node. one sentence is enough.

alex: adding all three. also including a `kubectl auth can-i` verify example:

alex:
```bash
kubectl auth can-i get secrets --namespace redwood-system --as=system:serviceaccount:redwood-system:kms-sa
```

docs-bot: quick reminder: run `make docs-lint`, update docs/TOC.md if you add a subsection, and add a short entry under CHANGELOG.md -> docs. linkcheck will fail on absolute internal URLs; prefer docs/reference paths.

alex: pushed changes to the branch with the SA/RoleBinding, CRI-O notes, Debian/RHEL commands, and the puppet/ansible one-liner. Ran make docs-lint locally and fixed heading warnings.

maya: CI shows a linkcheck failure for an internal RFC link in the migration section. changed it to docs/reference/hsm-transition.md as that is the public path.

sam: quick nit: we should show an imagePullSecrets minimal YAML for customers using a mirrored OCI registry behind auth. keeps support tickets lower.

alex:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: mirror-pull-secret
  namespace: redwood-system
type: kubernetes.io/dockerconfigjson
stringData:
  .dockerconfigjson: |
    {"auths": {"mirror.internal:443": {"auth": "<base64>"}}}
```

linh: also add a short troubleshooting checklist at the end: 1) verify node trusts mirror CA, 2) restart CRI, 3) kubelet logs for image pull errors, 4) `kubectl describe pod` to see image pull secrets used.

maya: agreed. can we backport to release/1.2.x after merge? a few customers will hit this during onboarding next week.

sam: i'll open the backport PR once this merges and ping customer-success (cc @marta-cs).

marta-cs: thanks — i'll draft a short customer-facing note and include the CRI-O steps. can you flag if there are any behavioral changes (none planned, right?) so I don't overstate it.

maya: no behavioral changes, just docs clarifications and extra platform examples. merging after CI green.

docs-bot: deploy-preview building. ETA ~5min. don't forget CHANGELOG entry.

maya: thanks all. will merge on green and follow up on backport + changelog.
